description: Full metric set for every cell in worker 4's persistence programme: 25 (symbol, timeframe) trade ledgers built from one full-history backtest each, sliced into the 1/3/6/9-month windows. Net of commission, exchange fee and the library's volatility- and liquidity-scaled slippage.
schema: per cell: symbol, timeframe_min, window_days, cell_aggregate (every trade in the cell pooled) and rows (top 25 by durability). Each row carries n, win_rate with its Wilson interval, avg_win_r, avg_loss_r, payoff_ratio, profit_factor, expectancy_r, total_r, std_r, t_stat, sharpe_per_trade, sortino, max_drawdown_r, avg_drawdown_r, max_consecutive_wins, max_consecutive_losses, avg_duration_min, avg_mfe_r, avg_mae_r, edge_ratio, by_session, clones, kind (real|placebo), arm, group, signals, filters, stop, target, durability, clears_free_t
costs: library CostModel: 0.5 tick base slippage, +1.0 on stops, +0.6 x upper-half ATR percentile, +1.0 thin book, +2.0 in a news window, plus commission and exchange fee in dollars charged once per round trip
caveat_on_pooling: These pooled figures are descriptive only. Per the project's M2 defect, pooled trade-level and pooled per-strategy statistics inflate z by roughly 3x; every inferential claim in the accompanying studies is made per cell and combined by sign test or Stouffer.
